title: MM6 Chain Fighter
description: Adult male MM6 chain-armored fighter: horned steel helmet with nasal guard and open brown face, broad red-rimmed steel shoulder plates, black chainmail neck/arms/legs, half mustard ochre and half dark red surcoat with small chest emblem, gray belt, silver greaves/bracers/boots. Left arm holds the long angular kite shield (viewer right in front): silver rim and four-point silver center emblem, ochre inset and gold boss. Right hand holds the small double-bladed axe; its blade is almost edge-on in the front idle and must stay narrow, not become a broad frontal blade. Side scabbard is visible. Preserve the stocky native silhouette and equipment placement exactly. Death falls backward with the shield and axe retaining their native positions.
regions: Separate enhanced-pixel coverage for ochre cloth/shield inset, red cloth, and steel armor/shield/weapon. Protect chainmail crevices, natural face, leather and outlines. Native palettes guide gold metal versus gray metal variants.
